about: Campus globe lamps measured from site photographs with solved cameras (2026-10-31), where OpenStreetMap has none. Each is placed on the ray through the lamp in the photograph, at the depth where the measured lamp model fills the lamp's pixels; y = foot height (m). [x, y, z, variant] in the v2 frame (x east, z south); variant 0 dark post, 1 pale post.
